TestAlternatorStreams::test_added_node_g.description: 3-node Alternator cluster (cdc + alternator-streams), KEYS_ONLY stream table prefilled, background write stress; bootstraps node4 and, via DescribeStream on node4, asserts that some shards are closed (have EndingSequenceNumber). Guards that a topology change creates a new CDC generation and that the new node's Streams API exposes the previous generation as closed shards (scylladb/scylla#8012 KCL stuck after decommission/add, regression fixed in scylladb/scylla#8209 / #8210). Vnodes: bootstrap commits a new generation immediately; tablets: node4 raises tablet-count floor -> split -> new per-table generation, polled up to 180s.

TestAlternatorStreams::test_updated_shar.description: 4-node cluster (racks 1/1/2), stream table prefilled, write stress, and a background thread repeatedly decommissioning/wiping/re-bootstrapping the last node. After each observed add-node + decommission cycle (detected via raft_topology log lines) it re-reads DescribeStream and asserts open shards always exist. Vnodes: open shards must change (new generation per topology change, up to 7 cycles); tablets: open shards must stay unchanged for 3 cycles (same rack re-bootstrap restores the tablet floor and merges are blocked with Streams). Origin reproducer attempt for scylladb/scylla#8012.

TestAlternatorStreams::test_verify_all_n.description: 3-node Alternator cluster with streams; creates a KEYS_ONLY stream table via node1 and writes 100 items. Then, for every node as coordinator, reads all shards of the stream (DescribeStream + GetShardIterator AT_SEQUENCE_NUMBER + GetRecords) and asserts the INSERT records' keys equal the written keys. Guards that the Streams view (shards + records) is consistent regardless of which node serves the request. No specific scylla issue; basic smoke test from the original Streams test infrastructure.

TestAlternatorStreams::test_verify_strea.description: 3-node Streams cluster, KEYS_ONLY table, then bootstraps node4/node5 (rack-valid). In 4 steps it writes 100 items via different nodes and between steps does topology ops: decommission node1, stop/start node4, remove (delete) node4. After each op it reads the whole stream from another coordinator (node1/node4/node3/node5) and asserts all INSERT keys written so far are present. Guards that Alternator Streams records survive CDC generation changes / streaming caused by bootstrap, decommission, restart and node removal (vnodes: new CDC generations; tablets: migrations/resize).

Asserts each page has exactly Limit streams, the union equals the 20 created ARNs, and a final call after the last ARN returns an empty list. Guards DynamoDB ListStreams Limit/paging semantics; no linked scylla issue.
